> [!WARNING]
> **This PR touches 3+ distinct areas of the codebase.**
>
> Consider splitting into smaller, focused PRs — each covering a single semantic type.
> This makes reviews easier and keeps the git history clean.

Categories found:

**docs:**
  - .changeset/rate-limit-per-client-ip.md
  - CONTRIBUTORS.md

**code:**
  - src/backend/server/dashboard.go
  - src/backend/server/server.go

**test:**
  - src/backend/server/server_test.go
<!-- Sticky Pull Request Commentpr-scope-warning -->

The only failing check here is **Check PR scope**: it flags the PR for touching docs (`.changeset/rate-limit-per-client-ip.md`, `CONTRIBUTORS.md`), code (`server.go`, `dashboard.go`) and tests (`server_test.go`) at once.

CONTRIBUTING asks for the changeset, a regression test and the CONTRIBUTORS entry together with the fix, so I'm not sure which way you'd prefer:

1. keep it as one PR and treat the scope check as an exception here, or
2. split the changeset and `CONTRIBUTORS.md` into a separate follow-up PR, leaving code + test here.

Happy to do either — just let me know.
